universities.campusLifestyle: Campus I and Campus II have different academic settings and schedules. The university combines regular teaching with student activities, practical work and support cells. Confirm the location of your department and any residential or transport arrangements before accepting an offer.
universities.cityProfile: The main university address is Bharathi Park Road in Coimbatore. Its School of Engineering is at Campus II in Varapalayam, off Mettupalayam Road. These locations should be considered separately when planning daily travel or accommodation. Ask for the current campus timetable and transport arrangements; a main-campus address does not mean that every programme is taught there.

Choose a programme by its exact curriculum and facilities. Industry activity and placement support do not guarantee an internship, employment or professional registration.

Confirm the relevant campus, current room allocation, deposits, mess charges and permission rules directly; an admission offer does not by itself confirm a room.
universities.dietarySupport: The School of Engineering prospectus describes vegetarian hostel food and drinking-water facilities. Confirm current arrangements at the campus where you will stay and discuss any dietary or allergy requirements before booking accommodation.
universities.safetyOverview: The university lists anti-ragging, grievance and complaints cells. Read the current campus and hostel rules and obtain the contacts relevant to your department and residence. Support arrangements and individual needs should be discussed before enrolment.

faq.question: Is Avinashilingam government-owned?
faq.answer: The university is governed by the Avinashilingam Education Trust/society and describes itself as UGC-funded. Government-aided programmes and public funding are distinct from government ownership. Compare the exact aided or self-financed admission route.

faq.question: Are both campuses in the same location?
faq.answer: The university has two constituent campuses. The main address is Bharathi Park Road, Coimbatore; the School of Engineering is at Campus II in Varapalayam. Confirm your exact department location and any transport or residential arrangements.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: English is the established general medium, with designated language-course exceptions. Tamil, Hindi and French majors use their respective languages under the Academic Council decision. Music also has a specific Tamil report-writing exception in the examination manual.

faq.question: What does an on-request tuition entry mean?
faq.answer: The university publishes course charges, but some figures combine several components or cover only the first semester. An on-request tuition entry means a separate annual tuition figure has not been reliably reconciled. Ask for an itemised category quotation before payment.

faq.question: Can international applicants apply?
faq.answer: The university invites international applications under its published category and equivalence rules. Exact programme approval, qualification, English requirements, NRI/OCI classification and fees still need confirmation. A university-wide invitation does not establish every professional programme route.

faq.question: Is the next intake date confirmed here?
faq.answer: Use the current programme admission notice for the next application and first-entry schedule. An older academic calendar or first-year commencement circular does not automatically establish the next cohort date.

faq.question: Are similarly named courses interchangeable?
faq.answer: No. Compare the exact science or engineering award, major, campus, duration and entry requirements. Aided and self-financed records may represent different admission and fee categories even when their degree titles are similar.

faq.question: Does admission guarantee hostel allocation or a job?
faq.answer: Neither a programme listing nor an admission offer guarantees a hostel room, internship or employment. Confirm room allocation and residential charges separately, and review the actual curriculum and support available for your chosen course.
